scope: BG/CS children-mode core encoding; independent cluster LLP stage
hardware: AMD Ryzen 7 PRO 4750U, 8 physical cores; one logical CPU per core
zero_workers_means: legacy serial entry path; final serial run checks drift

encoding.timing_includes: sorted-neighbor preparation, FULL cost search, serial emission and file writing
encoding.timing_excludes: input loading and vertex-width-matched JIT warmup
encoding.validation: SHA-256 equality across every worker setting, then full adjacency equality

llp.rng_policy: per-cluster Xoshiro; UInt64 seeds drawn in stable cluster order from MersenneTwister(53)
llp.timing_includes: cluster construction, induced subgraphs, cluster LLP, concatenation
llp.timing_excludes: Leiden partitioning and final graph relabeling
llp.validation: order SHA-256 equality across worker settings

protocol: one warmed run per worker setting; serial brackets; GC enabled and collected before each run; encoding/LLP timings separate
limitations: parallel children search excludes exact-cost trial writers and indexed mode
